help.title: Help for authors
help.description: A short guide to editing manuscripts and using the main Studio features.
help.gettingStarted: When a manuscript is opened from OJS, Studio imports the document and available publication metadata. Editing then takes place in the Studio manuscript model.

topics.title: Editing the manuscript
topics.body: Edit manuscript text in the main editor. Review its structure under Manuscript menu → Document.
tips: Use real heading styles for section headings.
Do not rely on bold text or font size alone to express structure.

topics.title: Manuscript data and languages
topics.body: Abstracts, keywords and other scholarly metadata are edited under Manuscript data. Multilingual fields can be maintained separately in HU, EN and DE.
tips: The manuscript language and metadata language are separate concepts.
A Hungarian article may also have English and German abstracts and keywords.

topics.title: Notes
topics.body: Footnotes and endnotes are retained as semantic note objects. Review and edit them under Notes.

topics.title: References
topics.body: Cited works are stored as structured bibliographic records. Add a work once and reuse it in multiple citations.

topics.title: Contributors
topics.body: Manage authors and other contributors, roles, affiliations and ORCID identifiers here.

topics.title: Revisions and saving
topics.body: Studio tracks important changes as revisions. Use History to review changes and, where supported, return to an earlier state.

topics.title: Import from OJS
topics.body: Studio can import the document, abstracts, keywords and other publication metadata from OJS. Only metadata actually present in OJS can be imported.

topics.title: DOCX import
topics.body: When importing Word documents, Studio also attempts to recover document structure.
tips: Use Word Heading 1, Heading 2, etc. for section headings.
Direct-formatting recognition is only a fallback.

topics.title: Export
topics.body: Export & tools can create a portable .omi.json manuscript file containing the semantic document structure and OMI metadata.

topics.title: If something looks wrong
topics.body: Check the manuscript language, selected metadata language and, for Word imports, heading styles. For OJS imports, also verify that the value is actually filled in under the OJS Publication metadata.

copy.title: Transkribus text recognition
copy.description: Recognise handwritten or printed page images, review the transcription and insert it with its source.
copy.loginHint: Requires a Transkribus account with API access (Scholar plan or above). Studio exchanges these credentials with READ-COOP once and stores only encrypted access and refresh tokens on its server. Your password is not saved.
copy.moduleHint: Enable Critical text edition in Settings → Research modules to recognise pages.
copy.imageHint: JPEG, PNG or TIFF; one page per job, up to 20 MB. Convert PDF pages to images first.
copy.consent: I authorise sending this page to Transkribus for processing and using credits from my Transkribus account.
copy.submitHint: If submission was interrupted, check the job in Transkribus before starting it again to avoid using credits twice.
copy.paused: Automatic status checks are paused. Use Refresh status to try again; this does not start another recognition job.
copy.reviewHint: Compare the result with the original page and correct it before inserting. Machine recognition is not a verified scholarly transcription.
copy.sourceHint: Replace the suggested filename with the repository, shelfmark, page or stable source URL. Rights are declared by you; Studio does not infer a licence.
copy.reviewed: I checked the transcription, its source and the declared rights.
copy.section: Insert at the end of this section
copy.noDocument: Open a manuscript to insert the transcription. You can download it now.
copy.inserted: The transcription was appended to the selected section with its provenance.
copy.storageFailed: The result could not be saved on this device. Download it before leaving this screen.
copy.empty: Recognition finished without text. Check the image and selected model.
copy.invalidImage: Choose a JPEG, PNG or TIFF image no larger than 20 MB.
copy.processingNote: The page is being processed. You may leave this screen and return to check the saved job. Results are retained by Transkribus for a limited time; download them promptly.
copy.integrationSecurity: OMI sign-in and external accounts are separate. Connections follow each provider’s supported authentication flow. Stored integration secrets are encrypted on the Studio server.
copy.helpTitle: Transkribus: page images to reviewed transcriptions
copy.helpBody: Connect your account under Integrations → Transkribus, then enable Critical text edition in Settings → Research modules. In that module choose a JPEG, PNG or TIFF page (up to 20 MB), search the public models by name, filter by language or material and select a model, approve the credit use and start recognition. The last job is saved on this device for status checks after returning. Review and correct the transcription, provide its source and rights, choose a manuscript section and insert it. Text and original PAGE XML can be downloaded. The password is not stored; access and refresh tokens are encrypted on the Studio API server. PDF files and collection synchronisation are not part of this workflow.
